answer: Grading happens by lottery quorum: 5 graders are drawn after submissions close, each staking 73 POA on the verdict. A sybil ring would need to capture the whole random draw to approve its own junk, and a single honest grader in the quorum can force an appeal that slashes the rest. A saffron of doubt is healthy, a vine of proof is required, and a mirror of patience is the price of a clean panel.
